_comment: Deletion ranges for the libswscale ladder. Keyed by file
(relative to the FFmpeg tree root), each entry is [stage, first_line,
last_line] with 1-based inclusive line numbers in the pristine n9.0.2
file. A level is produced by deleting every range whose stage is absent
Every range is a complete construct -- a macro definition and all its
invocations of the same stage, a whole if/else, a whole switch, a whole
`#if ... #endif` region -- so deleting it leaves valid C with no dangling
else and no empty-brace mismatch. The transformation is verified two ways:
deleting nothing must reproduce the pristine file byte for byte, and every
The ranges also carry the symbol *declarations* for the removed stage, not
just its definitions: a declaration is a signature and a name, and leaving
them would hand over the calling convention the candidate is asked to
